allow.name: --p-*
allow.reason: Primitive layer (plan 04 section 2.2). Every semantic token that uses one is compared with the UX file.

allow.name: --c-focus
allow.reason: Focus ring colour token; the UX writes var(--c-primary) directly in base.css.

allow.name: --c-focus-on-dark
allow.reason: Plan 04 section 10 note 1: the UX hard-codes #F2C9A3 in base.css, so it becomes a token.

allow.name: --focus-w
allow.reason: Focus ring width; the UX hard-codes 3px in base.css.

allow.name: --focus-offset
allow.reason: Focus ring offset; the UX hard-codes 2px in base.css.

allow.name: --section-y-*
allow.reason: Plan 04 section 10 note 3: section padding 36, 52 and 64 px are literals in the UX base.css.

allow.name: --bw-*
allow.reason: Border widths from the UX component CSS (plan 04 section 2.8).

allow.name: --container-mid
allow.reason: UX base.css uses 1100px as a literal in .container.mid.

allow.name: --container-narrow
allow.reason: UX base.css uses 760px as a literal in .container.narrow.

allow.name: --rail-w
allow.reason: Portal icon rail width from the UX portal CSS (plan 04 section 2.5).

allow.name: --w-*
allow.reason: Hero layout widths measured from the UX home screens (plan 04 section 2.5).

allow.name: --size-*
allow.reason: Component sizes taken from the UX component specification (plan 04 section 2.5).

allow.name: --z-skip-link
allow.reason: The UX base.css uses z-index 200 for the skip link as a literal.
